# Values transcribed from the dataset publication

`fedbca_publication_table1_2.csv`: per-tumour characteristics (Table 1) and T2WI acquisition parameters (Table 2) of
Cao K et al., *Sci Data* 2024;11:1147 (PMC11489429), transcribed on 2026-11-09 from the Europe PMC full-text XML.
These variables are not part of the released FedBCa files and could not be verified against them, except the MIBC
counts (T2 + T3 + T4 per centre = 30, 25, 13 and 17, matching the released labels). Totals in the "All" column were
computed by summing the per-centre counts. Daggers (†) mark them in Table 1 of the manuscript.
